steps.what: Find and read the actual livestock or crop technique reference and demonstration instructions in {DOCS}
Demonstrate actual growing or harvesting techniques and observe the farmer's understanding and practice

Advise farmers and demonstrate techniques in areas such as feeding and health maintenance of livestock, growing and harvesting practices, and financial planning, discussing applicability and limitations

tasks.design: Use native source search in {DOCS} to locate the actual demonstration reference. The educator reads it, performs the demonstration and gives case-specific advice; no generated treatment, pesticide instruction or financial decision is issued.
tasks.previous_blocker: Relevant technique references may require repeated manual searching.
tasks.enabler_now: Native indexed retrieval can find the original reference.
tasks.still_hard: Local growing conditions, practical skill and the farmer's understanding remain central.
tasks.human_edge: The educator sees whether the technique is workable and understood in the actual setting.

ambition.what: No new clinical, agronomic or financial authority.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-4 for reference access and farm confidentiality; national consultation if applicable

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: source retrieval can assist preparation for agricultural demonstrations without replacing physical teaching or case-specific advice.

assumptions: Representative episode is an actual growing-technique demonstration and discussion. Reference authors supply existing instructions; s1 verifies their date and context. Unindexed or missing sources are found manually; no new curated corpus is assumed free.

No written farm plan, prescription, report or follow-up send is established here. If the actual advice includes such an artefact, separate its real writing and any authorized send before estimating that episode. Demonstration equipment and farmer participation are existing baseline work, unchanged rather than shifted.

Native search first; existing effective retrieval earns no new gain. No physical technique is automated. The varied livestock and financial-planning branches require their own real work and authority before extrapolation.
Shares are hypotheses for the actual visit, not measured preparation or advisory baselines.
unknowns: Mix of demonstrations and financial or livestock advice
research_questions: Does native search already find the actual demonstration reference directly?

already_counted.description: Source reading, demonstration and full advice remain.

incremental.description: Check reference-search settings when source collections change.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=95.5, gross=4.5; upkeep 1 gives net 3.5. Low zero when the educator already has the current reference at hand, so no additional retrieval setup is introduced.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Deliver farming and home management classes

steps.what: Open and read the existing session materials and selected references in {DOCS} for the actual class
Conduct classes or deliver lectures on subjects such as nutrition, home management, and farming techniques, explaining concepts and responding to learner questions

tasks.design: Configure direct links to the current session materials in {DOCS}. The educator reads the materials and delivers the actual class; software does not substitute generated explanations for teaching or infer learning completion.
tasks.previous_blocker: Opening the current class references can require repeated navigation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native session links can remove some navigation.
tasks.still_hard: Clear explanation and responsive teaching depend on the actual learners.
tasks.human_edge: The educator notices confusion and adapts the explanation.

ambition.what: No new learner group is claimed.

build_days.consent_and_access: 0-2 for material access; national consultation if applicable

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: direct current-material links can reduce navigation without reducing live class delivery.

assumptions: Boundary is actual delivery using existing materials, whose creation belongs to real programme preparation and is neither newly required nor made free by this change. S1 reads and verifies current references. Missing or changed materials require actual manual preparation, outside this unchanged-material episode rather than a free generated lesson.

No attendance entry, learner evaluation or post-class report is established by the statement. If actually required, split its writing and any send before evaluating that broader workflow. Completion records, if any, must follow the actual class, never precede it.
Native links first; existing direct access earns no new gain. No annual course setup is charged per lecture. Shares are provisional active work, not a measured teaching baseline.
research_questions: Is there any repeated material navigation left during an actual class?

already_counted.description: Material reading and all actual teaching remain.

incremental.description: Check current-material links after session revisions.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=98, gross=2; upkeep 0.5 gives net 1.5. Low zero when materials already open directly, so add no duplicate configuration. Actual delivery is fully retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Read and verify the producer's actual production and input records and capture item, date, unit and comparison rules in {SPREADSHEET}
Observe actual production conditions with the producer and investigate context and missing facts
Transfer exact selected production and input quantities into the actual {SPREADSHEET} comparison table
Calculate the explicitly selected yield, input and period comparisons in {SPREADSHEET}, retaining unknowns and their source references
Collaborate with producers to diagnose and prevent management and production problems, interpreting the original records, farm context and comparisons together

tasks.design: Configure exact record imports and explicit comparison calculations in {SPREADSHEET}. The educator verifies the original records, observes the farm and interprets the comparisons with the producer; software does not diagnose a cause or prescribe a production change.
tasks.previous_blocker: Actual farm comparisons can require repeated transcription and arithmetic.
tasks.enabler_now: Native imports and formulas can perform defined comparisons transparently.
tasks.still_hard: Correlation in production records does not establish cause, and farm conditions may invalidate comparisons.
tasks.human_edge: The educator and producer connect the numbers with actual practice and limitations.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-6 for producer record permission and confidentiality; national consultation if applicable

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: exact farm-record imports and explicit arithmetic can support collaborative diagnosis without deciding a production cause.

assumptions: Representative episode is a production problem actually investigated with manual record comparisons, not every advisory visit. Producers create existing dated input/output records in ordinary farm work. S1 counts educator reading, unit checking, selection, mapping and rule capture; s2 counts investigation of missing context. New producer capture is not assumed free; absent records require manual investigation and remove the associated automation gain.

Fields are item, date/period, quantity, unit and source identifier. S3 explicitly imports them and s4 computes only rules chosen in s1. Unknown and incomparable values remain flagged, not imputed. Native configuration first; existing imports and formulas earn no new gain.

The actual comparison artefact is separate from observation and conversation. No independent written action plan or report is established for this episode; if required, split its writing and any real authorized send. Farmer implementation is unchanged baseline work, not automatic control or free new labour.
Shares are hypotheses for the record-based episode, not measured agricultural baselines or outcome promises. Do not extrapolate this to non-record-based collaborations.
research_questions: Which actual farm comparisons are manually transcribed or calculated today?

already_counted.description: Source verification and rule capture, farm investigation and full collaborative interpretation remain.

incremental.description: Maintain producer-format mappings and test comparisons after unit or recording changes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=70, gross=30; upkeep 4 gives net 26. Conservative case: inconsistent farm records leave only 7 import/calculation points avoidable, giving 7-4=3. Actual observation, source capture and problem interpretation remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Clarify the farmer's question and capture crop or livestock context, location and requested scope
Research information requested by farmers by locating original research and extension references through the {OTHER} agricultural reference catalogue
Read original sources and evaluate their evidence, date, conditions and relevance to the actual farm question
Write the actual research findings and exact references in the {DOCS} working research note, checking every claim against original sources
Save the research note in the same {DOCS} file without sending advice

tasks.design: Configure source search in the {OTHER} agricultural reference catalogue and exact reference fields in {DOCS}. The educator clarifies the request, reads original research and writes the findings and limits; the tool supplies no unsupported agricultural recommendation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Research requests may require repeated catalogue scanning and reference transcription.
tasks.enabler_now: Native search and reference export can reduce locating and citation-entry work.
tasks.still_hard: Experimental conditions and evidence quality may not match the farmer's setting.
tasks.human_edge: The educator decides which finding is relevant and where the evidence stops.

ambition.what: No new advisory service or source-coverage claim.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-4 for reference and farm-information access; national consultation where applicable

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: catalogue search and exact reference export can support agricultural research while original-source appraisal remains human.

assumptions: Boundary is research with an actual working findings note, not delivering the advice already covered in 10976. If research is retained only orally, remove the note and estimate the real episode; do not invent reporting time.

Source authors and catalogue maintainers produce existing records. S1 captures the farmer's actual scope; s2 verifies resolved sources and s3 reads them fully. Unavailable or unindexed sources require manual retrieval, not a free new corpus or invented citation.

S4 captures every finding and its limitation; only exact references and fixed question fields carry through. Native search/export first; existing functions earn no new gain. No model is required to locate sources or copy references.

Same-system save is negligible, minimum share 1 fully retained and ungated without self-approval. An actual farmer-facing written answer must have separate real authority and send after its final version exists. Shares are provisional, not measured research times.
research_questions: Which actual request searches remain manual after native catalogue filters are used?

already_counted.description: Question capture, source verification, full reading and findings meaning checks remain.

incremental.description: Check catalogue fields and reference-export mappings as source formats change.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=83.6, gross=16.4; upkeep 2 gives net 14.4. Low zero when sources are unindexed or current search and reference export already remove the repetition, so add no duplicate configuration.
